post.summary: Upload image evidence in one call
post.description: Plain REST alias for /photos/upload using image terminology. Send raw JPEG/PNG/WebP bytes with metadata query params, multipart form data with a file field, or JSON with exactly one public sourceUrl, dataUrl, or fileBase64 image. MovingManifest stores the original, reads dimensions, finalizes the evidence record, creates web-ready derivatives server-side, can optionally queue AI photo-review suggestions, and returns agentReview so assistants can summarize assumptions without asking for every field.

parameters.name: moveId
parameters.description: Required when uploading raw image bytes.

parameters.name: room
parameters.description: Readable room label for raw image byte uploads.

parameters.name: caption
parameters.description: Caption for raw image byte uploads.

parameters.name: photoType
parameters.description: Photo type for raw image byte uploads.

parameters.name: generateAiSuggestions
parameters.description: Set true for raw image byte uploads when the photo should also enter AI photo review. Requires inventory/write for queueing; upload can still succeed if review queueing fails.

201.description: Photo record created and derivative processing attempted.

MovingManifest stores the original, reads dimensions, finalizes the evidence record, creates web-ready derivatives server-side, can optionally queue AI photo-review suggestions, and returns agentReview so assistants can summarize assumptions without asking for every field.

post.summary: Batch upsert rough boxes and large loose movable units
post.description: Create or update the rough load-planning list where each row is either a box/carton or a large loose item that moves as-is. Use this before every box is itemized. New loose items require externalSource plus externalId; code-less new boxes require a stable idempotency key for live writes.

aiContract.description: Agent-facing rules, first-call guidance, and workflow hints.

PhotoDirectUpload.description: JSON shape for one-call JPEG, PNG, or WebP upload for agents through /images/upload or /photos/upload. Provide exactly one of sourceUrl, dataUrl, or fileBase64. REST clients with local files can also use multipart/form-data or raw image bytes; MCP clients should use upload_photo with filePath. Set generateAiSuggestions true to queue photo-intake review suggestions after upload.

sourceUrl.description: Public HTTP(S) JPEG, PNG, or WebP URL. Localhost, private-network, and credentialed URLs are rejected.

dataUrl.description: Base64 image data URL such as data:image/jpeg;base64,...

fileBase64.description: Raw base64 JPEG, PNG, or WebP bytes. Use this for REST clients that read a local image file.

generateAiSuggestions.description: When true, queue AI photo-intake suggestions after upload. The queueing step requires inventory/write in addition to photos/write; upload can still succeed if review queueing fails.

agentLabel.description: Human-readable agent or API key label. Defaults to the API key name on creates when omitted.

aiConfidenceScore.description: Whole-record AI confidence from 0 to 1. Separate from measurement confidence fields.

PhotoMultipartUpload.description: Multipart one-call JPEG, PNG, or WebP upload for REST agents through /images/upload or /photos/upload. Use a file, image, or photo field for the binary image and normal form fields for metadata. Include generateAiSuggestions=true to queue photo-intake review after upload.

file.description: JPEG, PNG, or WebP image file. The field may also be named image or photo.

generateAiSuggestions.description: When true, queue AI photo-intake suggestions after upload.

agentLabel.description: Human-readable agent or API key label. Defaults to the API key name on creates when omitted.

aiConfidenceScore.description: Whole-record AI confidence from 0 to 1. Separate from measurement confidence fields.

zones.description: Property/lot/excluded outdoor zones such as garage, carport, patio, deck, yard, driveway, or lot bounds.

PhotoDerivativeVariant.description: Private storage keys are intentionally omitted. This describes the web-ready derivative variants MovingManifest prepares for display and AI review after an original image upload.

derivativeNote.description: Human-readable summary of server-side derivative handling.

derivativeVariants.description: Structured thumb/card/detail/full derivative contract for the uploaded image. It confirms web display variants without exposing private storage keys.

aiReview.description: Present only when generateAiSuggestions was requested. status is queued when suggestions were created or reused, and failed when upload succeeded but review queueing did not.

agentReview.description: Short assistant-facing summary of the upload choices to tell the user for non-aggressive correction.

decisions.description: Caption, attachment target, privacy/type choices, confidence, notes, and AI review request used for this upload.

expiresAt.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when the display URL expires.

agentLabel.description: Human-readable agent or API key label. Defaults to the API key name on creates when omitted.

aiConfidenceScore.description: Whole-record AI confidence from 0 to 1. Separate from measurement confidence fields.

destinationSpaceId.description: Stable moveSpaces id for the destination location. Use destinationRoom as the readable fallback label.

destinationSpaceName.description: Exact active move space name to resolve as the box destination location.

agentLabel.description: Human-readable agent or API key label. Defaults to the API key name on creates when omitted.

aiConfidenceScore.description: Whole-record AI confidence from 0 to 1. Separate from measurement confidence fields.

assignedResourceId.description: Transport resource id when this unit has already been assigned to a truck, trailer, storage resource, owner vehicle, or similar load target.

assignedZoneId.description: Optional transport zone id inside the assigned resource.

assignmentOverrideReason.description: Required explanation when the user intentionally accepts assignment warnings.

agentLabel.description: Human-readable agent or API key label. Defaults to the API key name on creates when omitted.

aiConfidenceScore.description: Whole-record AI confidence from 0 to 1. Separate from measurement confidence fields.

PhotoDisplayMedia.description: Derivative display readiness and URL metadata for API/MCP agents. Signed URLs are short-lived; displayUrlPath can be called to refresh them.

url.description: Short-lived derivative URL when this response can safely sign one; otherwise null.

displayUrlPath.description: Relative API path for requesting a fresh short-lived derivative URL.

boxId.description: Existing box id to patch. Omit for create/upsert-by-code.

name.description: Alias for label, useful when the source rough list uses name.

count.description: For new code-less rows such as "12 medium boxes". Do not use with boxId or code.

photoIds.description: Existing photo IDs to attach to this explicit box row after the box is created or updated. Do not combine with count; expand photographed boxes into one row per physical box.

itemId.description: Existing inventory item id to patch as a large move-as-is loose unit.

externalSource.description: Required with externalId for new loose items so retries update the same movable unit.

externalId.description: Required with externalSource for new loose items so retries update the same movable unit.

dryRun.description: When true, validates and returns the lower-level box/item requests without writing.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable batch key required for live writes that create code-less auto-coded boxes. Header Idempotency-Key is also accepted by the API.

requests.description: Dry-run lower-level requests that would be made.

items.description: Underlying batch-upsert item result for loose items.
